label: Alternate wetting and drying
crosswalk: Rice Cultivation (AWD); Go caveated; Alliance row 5
system: Irrigated lowland rice with controllable water
definition: Repeated drain and re-flood cycles managed against a field water table or soil moisture threshold; safe or moderate AWD (re-flood at about 15 cm below surface) is the Crosswalk practice
comparator: Continuous flooding (h48); where the scheme imposes drying, the farmers' actual water regime
synonyms: alternate wetting and drying;AWD;intermittent irrigation;controlled irrigation;safe AWD
notes: Not AWD: single midseason drainage (b14.1), other reduced water use (b14.2), rainfed or upland rice, schemes without water control. Severe AWD is extracted but kept apart by its threshold. AWD inside an SRI package goes to sri unless the contrast isolates AWD. Hazard is irrigation water scarcity, not rainfed drought

label: Biochar
definition: Field application of pyrolysed biomass, alone or with fertiliser where the control gets the same fertiliser; includes charcoal fines and pit or Kon-Tiki kiln char where the feedstock is stated
comparator: Same field and fertiliser regime, no biochar
notes: Pot and incubation studies are mechanism evidence only. Ash (b74) and biochar as a feed additive are out. Biochar compost blends and biochar based fertilisers are partial_bundle unless the char is isolated. Record dose_farm_feasible

label: Rotational or planned grazing
crosswalk: Livestock sustainable rangeland management; Go enhancement; Alliance row 19
definition: Rotation among paddocks or grazing units, planned or holistic grazing with deliberate rest, and deferred grazing, seasonal reserves and by-law enclosures on communal land (subtype deferred)
comparator: Continuous or open grazing (h11); on communal land, uncontrolled communal grazing with its usual mobility
synonyms: rotational grazing;planned grazing;holistic grazing;holistic planned grazing;deferred grazing;grazing management;rotational resting;grazing reserve;kalo;olopololi;controlled grazing
notes: Cut and carry or zero grazing (d20) goes to feed_mgmt or fodder_banks. Permanent exclosures with no grazing or cutting are out, as are bush clearing or reseeding alone. Improved pasture sowing with rotation is partial_bundle. ERA does not cover this practice: expect grey literature and carbon project documents

label: Conservation agriculture bundle
crosswalk: Reduced Tillage; Go at CA bundle level; Alliance row 10
definition: Minimum soil disturbance (b38 or b39) plus retained residue cover (b27 family); rotation optional and recorded
comparator: Conventional tillage (h6) with residues removed (h35), burnt (h36) or grazed (h39)
synonyms: conservation agriculture;no-till;zero tillage;minimum tillage;reduced tillage;ripping;direct seeding;mulch;residue retention;soil cover
notes: Tillage change with residues removed is partial_bundle, extracted but not pooled. Residue incorporation (b41) and plastic mulch (b26) are not CA. Record residue cover measured at planting and years since conversion. Cover crop contrasts with tillage and residue held constant go to cover_crops

label: Cover crops
crosswalk: Cover Crops; Go bundle aware with reduced tillage; Alliance row 8
definition: Non-harvested plants grown in rotation or relay with the main crop to cover the soil
comparator: Same system with bare fallow between seasons
notes: Harvested legumes in rotation or intercrop (b3.x, b25, b50.x) are crop diversification, out of scope. CA versus conventional contrasts go to ca_bundle. Can compete for water: watch for negative effects

label: Nutrient management (scenario b)
crosswalk: Nutrient Management; Go enhancement; Alliance row 6
definition: Efficiency practices at equal or lower nutrient input than farmer practice: ISFM, micro-dosing, deep placement, split application, site-specific rates
comparator: Farmer or recommended fertiliser practice (h10, h10.2), not no fertiliser (h10.1)
synonyms: integrated soil fertility management;ISFM;micro-dosing;microdosing;deep placement;fertilizer use efficiency;fertiliser use efficiency;site-specific nutrient management;4R
notes: Plain rate increases against zero or low fertiliser are out: that is the business as usual pathway. ISFM with an improved variety is partial_bundle. Liming (b32) is out. Scenario b definition not yet closed with TNC: flag borderline contrasts rather than excluding them

label: Trees in farmlands
crosswalk: Parklands and Intercropping (alley cropping); both Go; Alliance row 12
definition: Crops grown under scattered or regularly spaced trees (subtype parkland) or in alleys between tree rows (subtype alley)
comparator: Same crop in open field, beyond tree influence
synonyms: parkland;scattered trees;on-farm trees;trees on farms;Faidherbia;Vitellaria;shea;alley cropping;hedgerow intercropping;FMNR;farmer managed natural regeneration;agroforestry
notes: Multistrata and shade tree crops (a12), boundary plantings (a9, a10), agroforestry fallows (a19.x) and prunings as a stand-alone amendment are out. Record tree age for every observation. Tree crop competition in dry years: watch for negative effects

label: Fodder banks
definition: A plot planted and reserved to supply feed in the dry season or feed gap, woody or herbaceous
notes: Browse from natural vegetation is out. Planted forages fed year round with no reserve function go to feed_mgmt. Feed_mgmt never takes fodder bank contrasts. Dry season feeding in a normal year is production; only the extra gain in a failed season is adaptation

label: Feed management
crosswalk: Feed Management; Go enhancement; Alliance row 18
definition: Forage quality improvement, conserved forage (hay, silage), crop residue treatment, balanced supplementation and planted forages fed year round
synonyms: feed management;forage conservation;silage;hay;urea treatment;crop residue treatment;supplementation;improved forage;Napier;Brachiaria
notes: Methane reducing feed additives (3-NOP, seaweed, oils) are out. Reserved fodder plots of any kind go to fodder_banks. Bare terms such as hay and supplementation must be combined with a livestock term

label: Silvopasture
definition: Deliberate combination of trees or shrubs with pasture and livestock
notes: Open rangeland with unmanaged natural tree cover is out. Not relevant for pastoralists; the mechanism is heat stress in mixed and dairy systems

label: Direct-seeded rice
crosswalk: Alliance addition on the SharePoint Crosswalk
era_codes: none; nearest b14.2 with h3 as control
definition: Dry or wet direct seeding in place of transplanting into puddled fields
synonyms: direct seeded rice;direct-seeded rice;dry seeding;wet seeding;DSR
notes: Same irrigation water scarcity method as awd. Direct seeding papers found by the ca_bundle string are screened here

label: System of Rice Intensification
crosswalk: Alliance addition on the SharePoint Crosswalk
definition: Defined bundle: young seedlings, wide spacing, intermittent irrigation, organic matter, weeding
notes: Record which components were applied; missing components make it partial_bundle. Same irrigation water scarcity method as awd

label: Enhanced rock weathering
definition: Silicate rock dust applied to cropland
comparator: Same field, no rock dust, same fertiliser
notes: Adaptation evidence only: stress season or water relation evidence. Production evidence comes from CIMMYT's module and is not reviewed here. Expect thin evidence

label: Boundary plantings
notes: Screened out at title and abstract and counted in the screening log. Blocked on the lack of an operational field boundary product for SSA: a data decision

label: Improved fallow
synonyms: improved fallow;planted fallow;fallow enrichment;sesbania fallow;tephrosia fallow
notes: Screened out at title and abstract and counted. Rotational clearing makes above ground carbon transient

label: Riparian buffers
notes: Screened out at title and abstract and counted. The mechanism works below one kilometre and cannot be produced at 5 arcmin

label: Multistrata and shade tree crops
crosswalk: Dropped by TNC; open joint item
definition: Tree crops under shade trees (coffee, cocoa)
notes: Will turn up under trees_in_farmlands searches. Screen out

label: Crop livestock integration as a named practice
notes: Screen out unless the contrast is one of the in scope livestock practices

label: Solar powered irrigation
notes: Screen out

label: Water harvesting
notes: Screen out

label: Improved varieties
notes: Screen out

label: Other
definition: An adaptation practice not covered by the codes above
notes: Never guess. A row coded other is listed for the team in the review sheet so the vocabulary can be extended
